info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investment Portfolio Management API
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and optimize their investment portfolios. By utilizing this API, users can create and modify investment portfolios, track performance metrics, and implement strategic asset allocation strategies. This service is designed for financial advisors, asset managers, and investment firms looking to enhance their portfolio management capabilities. Streamlining investment processes, it supports operations such as portfolio creation, updates, and performance evaluation.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new investment portfolio by providing the necessary details. Users can specify various attributes related to their investment strategy which will be stored for future management and analysis.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating an investment portfolio. This should include all the necessary details regarding the investment strategies, asset allocations, and any specific instructions related to portfolio management.
